name: aegis-disaster-response
description: Real-time disaster response platform. Monorepo root owns scripts only; each app owns its own dependencies.

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
